last_batch.research: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 and PubMed E-utils were queried for all 30 topics with exact intervention-name checks on returned records. New evidence used PMIDs 30726692, 36194412, 32445440, 28460892, 34347860, 35644166, 37224198, 37210099, 30184455, 39758759, 7485207, 35065036, 22670901, 31880796, 8923126, 24401022, 22595799, 24107292, 22724620, and 18242413. Duplicate source PMIDs were reused only where the same verified comparison applied to closely related worklist topics. Each new entry has a numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect, Korean subjects, and a mapped prescription-drug category. Seven topics were rejected because verified ClinicalTrials.gov/PubMed evidence did not provide an eligible single-topic numeric comparator effect: moxifloxacin Infection, ritonavir Hepatitis C, ritonavir COVID, ritonavir HCV Infection, upadacitinib Inflammatory Disease, valbenazine Schizophrenia, and dabrafenib Lung Carcinoma. Ritonavir combination evidence was not attributed to ritonavir alone.
